Ganache 101

Time: time
Servings: servings
Source: source
Tags: tested, sweet, dessert, simple, medium-effort, vegetarian, gluten-free, support-files

Ingredients

  • Chocolate
  • Heavy cream

Instructions

Instructions are roughly the same for any type. Chop chocolate, heat cream, pour cream over chocolate to melt it, let cool. What differs are the ratios of chocolate and cream.

Ratios

Chocolate type Chocolate:Cream Use
White 2.5:1 truffles
White x:x whipped
White x:x spread
White x:x pour
Milk x:x truffles
Milk x:x whipped
Milk x:x spread
Milk x:x pour
Dark x:x truffles
Dark x:x whipped
Dark x:x spread
Dark x:x pour

Examples

Lavender white chocolate truffles: 250g white chocolate, 100g cream, 2g lavender. Let lavender steep in the cream as it heats up. Let cool in the fridge, roll into balls quickly and coat in glitter sugar. Stick back into fridge if it starts to stick to hands.
